toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create complete standalone HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript, no dependencies, implementing polished classic two-snake arena on exactly 30x30 grid. Dark navy modern arcade aesthetic, mint green and violet snakes, coral food, attractive typography using system fonts, responsive canvas and sidebar/cards, clear score HUD for both players and mode/status. Start menu overlay with clickable three mode selections Human vs Human, CPU vs Human (player1 CPU, player2 human arrows), CPU vs CPU and start button. Default Human vs Human. Explain player1 WASD and player2 arrows, space pause, R restart, Esc menu. Game over overlay winner/draw and final scores with restart and menu buttons. Enter starts from menu or restarts on game over; R restarts current mode anytime. Render crisp 30x30 grid in canvas with snakes distinguishable head/eyes and food. Continuous fixed timestep ~120ms via requestAnimationFrame accumulator, reset timing on pause, no duplicate loops. Initialize snakes on opposite halves away from walls, heading toward center on different rows, length 4. Shared food randomly chosen among all free cells, eating grows by one and adds 10 score. Each simultaneous tick compute intended heads, growth, retained bodies (exclude tail only when not growing), resolve wall/body/self collisions, same target head and head-swap collisions; either death ends round, both deaths draw, survivor winner irrespective of score. Handle full board as round over score comparison. Keyboard controls prevent reverse directions and lock one accepted turn per snake per tick to prevent rapid keypress reversal; ignore keyboard repeat for toggle/restart keys. CPU uses BFS search towards food with occupied cells blocked, avoiding reverse, next-step opponent head reachable cells when possible, using flood fill reachable area to favor safe options and fallback largest-space move if food path unavailable. CPU must actually pursue food using path distances rather than random movement. Both CPUs use same snapshot. If no safe move, choose non-reverse direction so collisions conclude honestly. Keep CPU logic bounded on 900 cells. Draw board in idle menu too, provide readable control guide and brief rules. DOM text via textContent, accessible buttons focus styles and canvas aria-label, responsive layout for narrow screens, reduced motion styling. All functionality completely self-contained in this one file. Write full production ready content now."}
